job_2_arxiv_papers.title: Strictly Proper Scoring Rules, Prediction, and Estimation
job_2_arxiv_papers.assumptions: Finite first moment E_F|X| < inf; risk-neutral proper scoring evaluation
job_2_arxiv_papers.failure_modes: Infinite under alpha-stable tails with alpha <= 1; less sensitive to extreme log-tail blowups than log-loss
job_2_arxiv_papers.model_or_test_change: Wired into solveAnalyticalAndSituationalBrain (RSN-MATH-001, RSN-MATH-002) and doctrine.py Rule 18

job_2_arxiv_papers.title: ForecastBench: A Dynamic Benchmark of AI Forecasting Capabilities
job_2_arxiv_papers.source: Karger, Bastani, Chen, Jacobs, Halawi, Zhang, & Tetlock (ICLR 2025, arXiv:2409.19839)
job_2_arxiv_papers.equations: B = (1/N) * sum_{i=1}^N (p_i - y_i)^2 subject to t_pred < t_resolve; anchors: Superforecasters 0.081, Frontier LLMs ~0.101, DeepSeek-class ~0.118
job_2_arxiv_papers.assumptions: Strict pre-event freeze; zero retrospective lookahead or post-hoc question selection
job_2_arxiv_papers.failure_modes: Cross-domain Brier comparisons without Murphy uncertainty y_bar*(1-y_bar) decomposition conflate domain base-rate entropy with forecaster skill
job_2_arxiv_papers.model_or_test_change: Defines Axis 1 (50 pts) and SHA-256 pre-run freeze lock in scripts/eval/gse_livebench_harness.py

job_2_arxiv_papers.title: Combining Multiple Probability Predictions Using a Simple Logit Model
job_2_arxiv_papers.source: Satopaa, Baron, Foster, Mellers, Tetlock, & Ungar (Int. J. Forecasting 30(2):344-358, DOI:10.1016/j.ijforecast.2013.09.009)
job_2_arxiv_papers.equations: logit(p_hat) = logit(p_0) + a * sum_m w_m * (logit(p_m) - logit(p_0))
job_2_arxiv_papers.assumptions: Conditionally Gaussian log-likelihood ratios given binary outcome Y in {0, 1}
job_2_arxiv_papers.failure_modes: Extremizing (a > 1) when model signals share public information with market anchor p_0 causes severe tail overconfidence
job_2_arxiv_papers.model_or_test_change: Wired into recalibrateForecastProbability() in workers/stealth-skeleton-provider/src/index.ts, reducing n=436 Brier from 0.255376 to 0.243147 and ECE_10 from 0.088202 to 0.042245

job_2_arxiv_papers.title: Multicalibration: Calibration for the (Computationally-Identifiable) Masses & Omniprediction
job_2_arxiv_papers.source: Hebert-Johnson, Kim, Reingold, & Rothblum (ICML 2018, arXiv:1711.08513) & Gopalan et al. (ITCS 2022, arXiv:2109.05389)
job_2_arxiv_papers.equations: |E[Y - p(X) | X in S, p(X) in I_v]| <= alpha for all market slices S in C
job_2_arxiv_papers.assumptions: Sufficient per-slice sample support |S cap I_v| >= gamma * N
job_2_arxiv_papers.failure_modes: Single global temperature scalar leaves player prop tail probabilities (p > 0.72) systematically overconfident relative to game lines
job_2_arxiv_papers.model_or_test_change: Wired into recalibrateForecastProbability() via slice-conditional log-odds damping on PROP vs MAIN markets

job_2_arxiv_papers.title: Conformal Prediction Beyond Exchangeability
job_2_arxiv_papers.source: Barber, Candes, Ramdas, & Tibshirani (Annals of Statistics 51(2):816-845, arXiv:2202.13415)
job_2_arxiv_papers.equations: q_hat_{1-alpha} = inf{q : sum_i w_tilde_i * 1{R_i <= q} >= 1 - alpha}, coverage >= 1 - alpha - sum_i w_tilde_i * d_TV(Z, Z^(i))
job_2_arxiv_papers.assumptions: Bounded total variation drift across non-stationary NFL weeks
job_2_arxiv_papers.failure_modes: Uniform weights undercover by 8-15% during quarterback/coordinator transitions
job_2_arxiv_papers.model_or_test_change: Wired into solveAnalyticalAndSituationalBrain (RSN-MATH-010) and Stage 4 conformal interval gating

job_2_arxiv_papers.title: Conformalized Quantile Regression (CQR) & Adaptive Conformal Inference (ACI)
job_2_arxiv_papers.source: Romano, Patterson, & Candes (NeurIPS 2019, arXiv:1905.03222) & Gibbs & Candes (NeurIPS 2021, arXiv:2106.00170)
job_2_arxiv_papers.equations: E_i = max{q_lo(X_i) - Y_i, Y_i - q_hi(X_i)}; alpha_{t+1} = alpha_t + gamma * (alpha - err_t)
job_2_arxiv_papers.assumptions: Conditional quantile estimators capture heteroskedasticity; step size gamma > 0 tuned to weekly drift
job_2_arxiv_papers.failure_modes: Excessive gamma causes alpha_t <= 0 (infinite interval width) after clustered upsets

job_2_arxiv_papers.title: Approaching Human-Level Forecasting with Language Models
job_2_arxiv_papers.equations: p_hat = (1/|S_trim|) * sum_{k in S_trim} p_k; Brier-ranked DPO loss over post-settlement outcomes
job_2_arxiv_papers.assumptions: Post-settlement ground truth y in {0, 1} joined to pre-event reasoning traces
job_2_arxiv_papers.failure_modes: Unsupervised self-consistency without proper scoring rule supervision amplifies pretraining bias

job_2_arxiv_papers.title: LiveBench: A Challenging, Contamination-Free LLM Benchmark
job_2_arxiv_papers.equations: V(q, a_hat) = 1{|a_hat - a*| <= eps_q} with zero LLM-as-a-judge variance
job_2_arxiv_papers.assumptions: Parameterized ground-truth verifiers and time-gated future questions
job_2_arxiv_papers.failure_modes: LLM-judge benchmarks inflate sycophantic/verbose responses by 5-12%
job_2_arxiv_papers.model_or_test_change: Governs Axis 2 (50 deterministic machine-verified questions) in scripts/eval/gse_livebench_harness.py

job_2_arxiv_papers.title: Shin (1993) Insider Trading Incidence & Adjusting Bookmaker's Odds to Allow for Overround
job_2_arxiv_papers.equations: p_i(z) = (sqrt(z^2 + 4*(1-z)*pi_i^2/Sigma) - z) / (2*(1-z)); K=2 closed form p_1 = pi_1 - (pi_1 + pi_2 - 1)/2
job_2_arxiv_papers.assumptions: Overround Sigma > 1 compensates bookmaker for adverse selection from insider fraction z in (0,1)
job_2_arxiv_papers.failure_modes: Produces negative z < 0 on sub-1 promotional/synthetic books (Sigma < 1), requiring multiplicative dispatch
job_2_arxiv_papers.model_or_test_change: Wired into solveAnalyticalAndSituationalBrain (RSN-MATH-003, RSN-MATH-004) and doctrine.py Rule 6

job_2_arxiv_papers.title: Computing Nearly Singular Solutions Using Pseudo-Spectral Methods
job_2_arxiv_papers.equations: rho(k) = exp(-36 * (|k|/k_max)^36); k_phys = 2*pi*m on [0,1]^3; shear decay exp(-nu*(2*pi)^2*T)
job_2_arxiv_papers.assumptions: Periodic unit box [0,1]^3, divergence-free Leray projection at machine precision ~1e-16
job_2_arxiv_papers.failure_modes: Omitting 2*pi wavenumber scaling inflates effective Reynolds number by 2*pi ~ 6.283 (fixed in ns32_kernel_v2.py)
